## Problem

Describe the behavior or documentation gap this change addresses.

## Changes

Summarize the implementation and user-visible result.

## Validation

List checks performed and their results. Include synthetic examples where useful.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and affected documentation is updated.
- [ ] Relevant checks were run, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] No credentials, patient information, or local database files are included.
- [ ] Model or schema changes explain compatibility and limitations, if applicable.
